column1: # Pipeline stage of each compiler source file, for the totality ratchet
# The longest matching path prefix wins. `proof` = yes marks the stages docs/compiler/VERIFIED_PIPELINE.md
# says get proven: principle 8, "semantics, checkers, validators and proved passes are total; untrusted
# search may stay partial", and the pass table (Check and Elab checked against the declarative
# relation, S8/R-0499; Mono's validator, S8a/R-0510; the Core -> Place MIR lowering, S10/R-0501; SSA
# validators, S12/R-0504; Core semantics and the reference evaluators, S7/R-0496; claims generated on
# Core, S9/R-0495). A non-total declaration in a `proof = yes` stage must carry a baseline reason;
# in every stage a NEW one fails the gate. `owner` is the roadmap row whose delivery needs the
# stage total; it becomes the baseline row's owner.
# Every compiler source file (Concrete.lean, Concrete/, and the executable root Main.lean) must
# match a prefix; the gate refuses an unmapped one. Browser.lean is not inventoried: see the gate.
